detail.description:
Location

A very nice option for those who like to be on the move! Hotel «Oyo 7148 Adore Inn» is located in Mumbai. This hotel is located in 7 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel — Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova Beach.

At the hotel

It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help you to stay on-line. Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry and a concierge.

Room amenities

Here’s what you’ll find in the room to have a rest after a long day: a shower and a TV. The room equipment depends on its category.

Location

A great place to have a rest after an exciting day! Hotel «Hotel Apple Inn» is located in Navi Mumbai. This hotel is located in 6 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova Beach.

At the hotel

It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help you to stay on-line. Specially for tourists who travel by car, there’s a free parking zone. The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion.

Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift. Additional services that the hotel offers to its guests: a laundry, dry cleaning and a safe-deposit box.

detail.description:
Location

Feeling like at home during the long journey is priceless. Guest house «Guest Inn Residency» is located in Mumbai. This guest house is located in walking distance from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the guest house — Juhu Beach, Powai Lake and Versova Beach.

At the guest house

Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help you to stay on-line. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone. The tour assistance desk of the guest house will help you book an excursion. If you want to make your journey even more comfortable, you can order a transfer.

At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning and car rental. The staff of the guest house speaks English.

detail.hotelName: Courtyard by Marriott Mumbai International Airport
detail.description:
Location

Sophisticated but very comfortable hotel «Courtyard by Marriott Mumbai International Airport» is located in Mumbai. This hotel is located in 7 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. Have a cup of coffee in the cafe and, who knows, maybe it’s going to be the best one in the city. Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help you to stay on-line.

If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone. Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room, a sauna, a steam bath and a spa center. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Get ready for a fun and exciting vacation! Here’s what you will find on the premises: a picnic area.

Swimming fans are going to enjoy a pool, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. For business meetings, there is a business center and event facilities. To book an excursion, consult the tour assistance desk of the hotel. The staff of the hotel will order a transfer for you.

Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift. At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English.

Room amenities

The room is warmly decorated and has everything you need to have a rest after a long eventful day. There is a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

Sophisticated but very comfortable hotel «Courtyard by Marriott Mumbai International Airport» is located in Mumbai. This hotel is located in 7 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. Have a cup of coffee in the cafe and, who knows, maybe it’s going to be the best one in the city. Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help you to stay on-line.

If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone. Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room, a sauna, a steam bath and a spa center. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Get ready for a fun and exciting vacation! Here’s what you will find on the premises: a picnic area.

Swimming fans are going to enjoy a pool, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. For business meetings, there is a business center and event facilities. To book an excursion, consult the tour assistance desk of the hotel. The staff of the hotel will order a transfer for you.

Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift. At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English.

Room amenities

The room is warmly decorated and has everything you need to have a rest after a long eventful day. There is a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.hotelName: Four Points by Sheraton Navi Mumbai, Vashi
detail.description:
Location

Good choice if you’re looking forward to taking some rest at the hotel as much as to walking around the city. Hotel «Four Points by Sheraton Navi Mumbai, Vashi» is located in Navi Mumbai. This hotel is located in 6 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova Beach.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Have a cup of coffee in the cafe and, who knows, maybe it’s going to be the best one in the city. Free Wi-Fi is available on the territory. Ask for more information when checking in.

If you travel by car, there’s a parking zone. The following services are also available for the guests: a massage room, a sauna, a steam bath and a spa center. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Get ready for a fun and exciting vacation! Here’s what you will find on the premises: a barbeque area.

Swimming fans are going to enjoy a pool and an outdoor pool. Want to have an excursion? Consult the tour assistance desk of the hotel. The staff of the hotel will order a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English.

Room amenities

Here’s what you’ll find in the room to have a rest after a long day: an alarm clock, a shower, a mini-bar and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

Good choice if you’re looking forward to taking some rest at the hotel as much as to walking around the city. Hotel «Four Points by Sheraton Navi Mumbai, Vashi» is located in Navi Mumbai. This hotel is located in 6 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova Beach.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Have a cup of coffee in the cafe and, who knows, maybe it’s going to be the best one in the city. Free Wi-Fi is available on the territory. Ask for more information when checking in.

If you travel by car, there’s a parking zone. The following services are also available for the guests: a massage room, a sauna, a steam bath and a spa center. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Get ready for a fun and exciting vacation! Here’s what you will find on the premises: a barbeque area.

Swimming fans are going to enjoy a pool and an outdoor pool. Want to have an excursion? Consult the tour assistance desk of the hotel. The staff of the hotel will order a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English.

Room amenities

Here’s what you’ll find in the room to have a rest after a long day: an alarm clock, a shower, a mini-bar and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

A great place to have a rest after an exciting day! Hotel «Shyanu Lords Eco Inn Airoli-Near Mindspace» is located in Navi Mumbai. This hotel is located in 16 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Powai Lake, Juhu Beach and Versova Beach.

At the hotel

It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. Free Wi-Fi is available on the territory. Ask for more information when checking in. Specially for tourists who travel by car, there’s a parking zone. For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you.

There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning and ironing.

detail.description:
Location

Good choice if you’re looking forward to taking some rest at the hotel as much as to walking around the city. Holiday Inn Dubai Business Bay Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 6 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel — The Dubai Fountain, Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo and Burj Khalifa.

At the hotel

You can stop by the restaurant. For participants of business meetings, there is a conference hall. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

detail.hotelName: Four Seasons Dubai at Jumeirah Beach Resort
detail.description:
Location

Here, you’ll be enjoying yourself all the time. Four Seasons Resort Dubai at Jumeirah Beach Hotel is located in Dubai. This resort is located in 9 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the resort — Jumeirah Beach, Jumeira Open Beach and Business Bay.

At the resort

You can stop by the bar. It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. The resort cafe is a nice place to have a snack. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available.

Specially for tourists who travel by car, there’s a parking zone. The beauty and wellness services: a massage room, a sauna, a steam bath and a spa center. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center, a gym, a table tennis area and a diving club. You won’t be bored as at the resort you will find a picnic area and a barbeque area.

Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. Children will be happy, there is a playroom for them. Want to have an excursion? Consult the tour assistance desk of the resort. The staff of the resort will order a transfer for you.

Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. There are other services available for the guests of the resort. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, private check-in and check-out, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the resort speaks English, Spanish, German, Russian, French and Korean.

Room amenities

In the room, there is an alarm clock, a shower, a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.description:
Location

Holiday Inn & Suites Dubai Festival City, an IHG Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 8 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. If you can’t live without coffee, drop by the cafe. Free Wi-Fi is available on the territory. Ask for more information when checking in.

If you travel by car, there’s a parking zone. The following services are also available for the guests: a massage room, a sauna and a spa center. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be an outdoor pool.

For participants of business meetings, there is a business center. The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion. The staff of the hotel will order a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

Additional services that the hotel offers to its guests: a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, ironing, press, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English and Spanish.

Room amenities

Here’s what you’ll find in the room to have a rest after a long day: a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.description:
Location

A very nice option for those who like to be on the move! Hotel «Premier Inn Dubai Barsha Heights» is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 7 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel — Dubai Internet City, Ski Dubai and Mall of the Emirates.

At the hotel

You can stop by the bar. It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help you to stay on-line. If you travel by car, there’s a parking zone.

The following services are also available for the guests: a doctor. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Tourists who can’t live without swimming will appreciate a pool and an outdoor pool. Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors.

At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing and a safe-deposit box. The staff of the hotel will be happy to talk to you in English.

Room amenities

The room is warmly decorated and has everything you need to have a rest after a long eventful day. There is a shower. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.description:
Location

A great hotel to have a nice rest before long walks around the city. Hotel «Premier Inn Dubai Silicon Oasis» is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 18 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Dubai Mall, The Dubai Fountain and Burj Khalifa.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. Have a cup of coffee in the cafe and, who knows, maybe it’s going to be the best one in the city. Free Wi-Fi is available on the territory. Ask for more information when checking in.

If you travel by car, there’s a parking zone. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center and a gym. Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool and an outdoor pool. The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion.

For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift. At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel will be happy to talk to you in English, Italian, Russian and French.

Room amenities

In the room, there is a shower, a TV and a mini-bar. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.description:
Location

Here, you’ll be enjoying yourself all the time. Four Seasons Resort Dubai at Jumeirah Beach Hotel is located in Dubai. This resort is located in 9 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the resort — Jumeirah Beach, Jumeira Open Beach and Business Bay.

At the resort

You can stop by the bar. It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. The resort cafe is a nice place to have a snack. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available.

Specially for tourists who travel by car, there’s a parking zone. The beauty and wellness services: a massage room, a sauna, a steam bath and a spa center. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center, a gym, a table tennis area and a diving club. You won’t be bored as at the resort you will find a picnic area and a barbeque area.

Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. Children will be happy, there is a playroom for them. Want to have an excursion? Consult the tour assistance desk of the resort. The staff of the resort will order a transfer for you.

Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. There are other services available for the guests of the resort. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, private check-in and check-out, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the resort speaks English, Spanish, German, Russian, French and Korean.

Room amenities

In the room, there is an alarm clock, a shower, a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

Here, you’ll be enjoying yourself all the time. Four Seasons Resort Dubai at Jumeirah Beach Hotel is located in Dubai. This resort is located in 9 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the resort — Jumeirah Beach, Jumeira Open Beach and Business Bay.

At the resort

You can stop by the bar. It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. The resort cafe is a nice place to have a snack. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available.

Specially for tourists who travel by car, there’s a parking zone. The beauty and wellness services: a massage room, a sauna, a steam bath and a spa center. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center, a gym, a table tennis area and a diving club. You won’t be bored as at the resort you will find a picnic area and a barbeque area.

Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool. Children will be happy, there is a playroom for them. Want to have an excursion? Consult the tour assistance desk of the resort. The staff of the resort will order a transfer for you.

Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. There are other services available for the guests of the resort. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, private check-in and check-out, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the resort speaks English, Spanish, German, Russian, French and Korean.

Room amenities

In the room, there is an alarm clock, a shower, a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.description:
Location

Novotel Bur Dubai Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 5 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room and a spa center.

Sports fans will be able to enjoy a gym. Swimming fans are going to enjoy an outdoor pool. For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, private check-in and check-out, ironing and a concierge.

Room amenities

Guests will find the following in the room: a TV, a mini-bar and a bathrobe. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

Novotel Bur Dubai Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 5 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room and a spa center.

Sports fans will be able to enjoy a gym. Swimming fans are going to enjoy an outdoor pool. For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, private check-in and check-out, ironing and a concierge.

Room amenities

Guests will find the following in the room: a TV, a mini-bar and a bathrobe. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.description:
Location

MENA Plaza Hotel Albarsha Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 20 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. The hotel cafe is a nice place to have a snack. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone for free.

If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone. The beauty and wellness services: a sauna. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center and a gym. Tourists who can’t live without swimming will appreciate an outdoor pool.

For business meetings, there is a conference hall. If you want to make your journey even more comfortable, you can order a transfer. Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. Additional services that the hotel offers to its guests: a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, a safe-deposit box and a concierge.

The staff of the hotel will be happy to talk to you in English.

Room amenities

In the room, for you, there is a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

MENA Plaza Hotel Albarsha Hotel is located in Dubai. This hotel is located in 20 km from the city center.

At the hotel

Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. The hotel cafe is a nice place to have a snack. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone for free.

If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone. The beauty and wellness services: a sauna. Sports fans are going to love a fitness center and a gym. Tourists who can’t live without swimming will appreciate an outdoor pool.

For business meetings, there is a conference hall. If you want to make your journey even more comfortable, you can order a transfer. Accessible for guests with disabilities: the elevator helps them to go to the highest floors. Additional services that the hotel offers to its guests: a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, a safe-deposit box and a concierge.

The staff of the hotel will be happy to talk to you in English.

Room amenities

In the room, for you, there is a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

detail.address: 9015-17, Desh Bandhu Gupta Road, New Delhi
detail.description:
Location

A great hotel to have a nice rest before long walks around the city. Hotel «Best Western Darbar» is located in New Delhi. This hotel is located in 5 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Karol Bagh Shopping Market, Jantar Mantar and Gurudwara Bangla Sahib.

At the hotel

It’s time to have a nice meal! Stop by the restaurant. Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help you to stay on-line. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone for free. For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you.

Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift. Additional services that the hotel offers to its guests: a laundry, dry cleaning, an ATM, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English.

Room amenities

Here’s what you’ll find in the room to have a rest after a long day: a mini-bar. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

Location

A very nice option for those who like to be on the move! Hotel «FabHotel Novel Suites» is located in New Delhi. This hotel is located in 15 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Dwarka, Parliament of India and Garden of Five Senses.

At the hotel

There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a safe-deposit box.

detail.description:
Location

You’d never want to leave such a hotel — hotel «Andaz Delhi, by Hyatt» is located in New Delhi. This hotel is located in 9 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Delhi Aerocity, Garden of Five Senses and Siri Fort Auditorium.

At the hotel

You can stop by the bar. Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone.

Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room, a sauna, a spa center and a doctor. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Get ready for a fun and exciting vacation! Here’s what you will find on the premises: a library. Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool.

The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion. You won’t have to leave your pet at home as they are allowed. If you want to make your journey even more comfortable, you can order a transfer. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English, German and French.

Room amenities

Guests will find the following in the room: an alarm clock, a shower, a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. The room equipment depends on its category.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

You’d never want to leave such a hotel — hotel «Andaz Delhi, by Hyatt» is located in New Delhi. This hotel is located in 9 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Delhi Aerocity, Garden of Five Senses and Siri Fort Auditorium.

At the hotel

You can stop by the bar. Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone.

Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room, a sauna, a spa center and a doctor. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a fitness center and a gym. Get ready for a fun and exciting vacation! Here’s what you will find on the premises: a library. Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool, an indoor pool and an outdoor pool.

The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion. You won’t have to leave your pet at home as they are allowed. If you want to make your journey even more comfortable, you can order a transfer. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift.

At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English, German and French.

Room amenities

Guests will find the following in the room: an alarm clock, a shower, a TV, a mini-bar, a bathrobe and slippers. The room equipment depends on its category.

detail.hotelName: DoubleTree by Hilton Gurugram Baani Square
detail.description:
Location

Want to take a rest and explore the city? Hotel «DoubleTree by Hilton Gurugram Baani Square» is located in Gurugram. This hotel is located in 5 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Garden of Five Senses, Siri Fort Auditorium and M Block Market.

At the hotel

You can stop by the bar. Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone.

Sports fans are going to love a fitness center and a gym. Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool and an outdoor pool. For participants of business meetings, there is a business center. The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion.

For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift. There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English.

Room amenities

Here’s what you’ll find in the room to have a rest after a long day: a TV. Please note that the listed services may not be available in all the rooms.

hotelDetailMap.title: Description
hotelDetailMap.data:
Location

Want to take a rest and explore the city? Hotel «DoubleTree by Hilton Gurugram Baani Square» is located in Gurugram. This hotel is located in 5 km from the city center. You can take a walk and explore the neighbourhood area of the hotel. Places nearby: Garden of Five Senses, Siri Fort Auditorium and M Block Market.

At the hotel

You can stop by the bar. Taste the local cuisine and have a rest in the restaurant. Want to be always on-line? Wi-Fi is available. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone.

Sports fans are going to love a fitness center and a gym. Here, you can treat yourself with water procedures as there will be a pool and an outdoor pool. For participants of business meetings, there is a business center. The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion.

For the free movement around the city, the hotel offers a transfer for you. Accessibility: there is an elevator/lift. There are other services available for the guests of the hotel. For example, a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, press, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English.
